title: Powhatan Festival of the Grape marks 23 years as community tradition
text:
Powhatan Festival of the Grape marks 23 years as community tradition
The Powhatan Festival of the Grape, described as Powhatan's largest single-day event, will celebrate its 23rd year on October 3, 2026. The event, organized by the Powhatan Chamber of Commerce, is considered a longstanding tradition that brings together residents and visitors from across Central Virginia for a day of wine, local vendors, food, music, and community connection.
According to the Powhatan Chamber of Commerce, "The Powhatan Festival of the Grape is more than Powhatan's largest single-day event—it's a true community tradition that brings people together from across Central Virginia for a day filled with great wine, local vendors, food, music, and connection. Behind the celebration is something even bigger. As the Chamber’s only fundraiser and primary source of revenue outside of membership dues, the Festival helps power the programs, community initiatives, and scholarship opportunities we invest in all year long. We’d love for you to be part of it! Join the celebration as a sponsor, volunteer for a morning or afternoon shift, or come enjoy the day with us. Every sponsor, volunteer, vendor, and attendee helps make this event what it is—and helps keep its impact going strong in our community. Here’s to 23 years of celebration, connection, and tradition in Powhatan!"
The Chamber encourages community members to participate as sponsors, volunteers, or attendees, emphasizing that the festival's success relies on broad support. The event serves as the Chamber’s only fundraiser and is its primary source of revenue aside from membership dues. Proceeds from the festival support programs, community initiatives, and scholarship opportunities throughout the year.
The Chamber is promoting the event through social media, inviting the public to follow for updates on festival announcements, vendor and winery spotlights, entertainment, and ticket information as the date approaches. The festival is held at 3860 Old Buckingham Road in Powhatan, Virginia.
The Chamber said, "Don't miss out on updates. The countdown to October 3, 2026, is on! Follow us on social media for festival announcements, vendor and winery spotlights, entertainment updates, ticket information, and all the excitement leading up to the biggest day of the year in Powhatan."
The Powhatan Festival of the Grape continues to be a central event for the community, supporting local initiatives and providing an opportunity for residents and visitors to connect each year.
